department: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
summary: Monthly financial assistance scheme for eligible women in Maharashtra to support economic independence.
benefits: Monthly cash assistance credited directly to the beneficiary's bank account.
eligibility: Age within the prescribed eligibility band
Family income below the prescribed limit
application_steps: Apply online via the Mahadbt/Nari Shakti Doot portal or nearest Anganwadi/Setu centre
